environment.description: Django REST API deployed on a single EC2 instance behind an ALB. PostgreSQL 14 on RDS with RLS policies defined on the documents table using `current_setting('app.current_tenant_id')`. The application runs under gunicorn with `preload_app=True` and `worker_class=sync`. During rolling deployments, SIGTERM is sent to workers. The DB role used by the application is the table owner (has BYPASSRLS privilege), meaning RLS policies are not enforced for this role. The RLS policy exists but is effectively a no-op for the connection role.

config.rls_policy: CREATE POLICY tenant_isolation ON documents USING (tenant_id = current_setting('app.current_tenant_id')::uuid)
